en-e1-l1.title: Ialfabhethi nesandi sokuqala
en-e1-l1.concept: Amagama akhunjulwa lula xa uwazi isandi sokuqala nonobumba wokuqala. Funda ngokuvakalisa izandi ulandela.

en-e1-l2.title: Imibuliso
en-e1-l2.concept: Xa udibana thetha **Hello**, xa uhlukana thetha **Goodbye**. Igama lithethwa nge-**My name is ...**.

en-e1-l3.title: Amanani nemibala
en-e1-l3.concept: Funda amanani one, two, three... namagama emibala red, blue, yellow...

en-e1-l4.title: Usapho
en-e1-l4.concept: Ngamagama abiza usapho anjengo mother (umama), father (utata), grandmother (makhulu), baby (usana).

en-e1-l5.title: Amagama egumbi lokufundela
en-e1-l5.concept: desk, chair, bag, pencil, book... Zama ukuthetha ngesiNgesi amagama asetyenziswa egumbini lokufundela.

en-e2-l1.title: Amagama ezilwanyana nezinto
en-e2-l1.concept: Amagama abonisa amagama anjengo rabbit (unomatse), bird (intaka), fish (intlanzi) abizwa ngokuba zii-**noun** (izibizo).

en-e2-l2.title: Amagama abonisa intshukumo
en-e2-l2.concept: Amagama abonisa intshukumo anjengo jump (tsiba), run (baleka), eat (tya) abizwa ngokuba zii-**verb** (izenzi).

en-e2-l4.title: Ukwenza izivakalisi ezifutshane
en-e2-l4.concept: Emva kwe I sebenzisa **am**, emva kwe You sebenzisa **are**. Isivakalisi silandela ulandelelwano 'ngubani → injani/yenza ntoni'.

en-e2-l5.title: Ukufunda umbhalo mfutshane
en-e2-l5.concept: Xa ufunda umbhalo, qala ufumane igama lombuzo kumbhalo.

en-e3-abc1.title: Oonobumba abakhulu nabancinci bealfabhethi
en-e3-abc1.concept: Ialfabhethi inoonobumba **abakhulu** nabo **abancinci**. Kukho izibini ezininzi ezinomlo owahlukileyo, ngoko khumbula ngamnye ngokubaxhasa. Qaphela ngokukodwa oonobumba abafanayo njengo b, d, p, q.

en-e3-l1.title: Ukwenza izivakalisi
en-e3-l1.concept: Isivakalisi silandela ulandelelwano 'ngubani → wenza ntoni → yintoni'. Kwisenzi emva kwe He, She namagama abantu yongeza **-s**.

en-e3-l3.title: Ixesha langoku nelidlulileyo
en-e3-l3.concept: Into yangoku okanye ephindaphindwayo sebenzisa **ixesha langoku**, kwaye into edlulileyo sebenzisa **ixesha elidlulileyo** elinoku-**-ed** ekupheleni kwesenzi.

en-e3-l4.title: Imisebenzi yemihla ngemihla
en-e3-l4.concept: get up, brush my teeth, eat breakfast, go to bed... Zama ukuthetha ngesiNgesi ngemisebenzi yakho yemihla ngemihla.

en-e3-l5.title: Ukuqonda umbhalo
en-e3-l5.concept: Funda umbhalo ufumane ukuba ngubani, nini nokuba wenze ntoni.

en-e3-snd1.title: Ubudlelwane phakathi kwesandi nokupela
en-e3-snd1.concept: Isandi sokuqala segama nonobumba wokuqala banobudlelwane. Funda ubudlelwane phakathi kwesandi nokupela ngokufumana amagama aqala ngesandi esifanayo. Oonobumba ababini abanjengo-ph nabo banokwenza isandi se-f.

en-e4-l1.title: Ixesha langoku, elidlulileyo nelizayo
en-e4-l1.concept: Into yangoku nephindaphindwayo ithethwa nge-**ixesha langoku**, into edlulileyo nge-**-ed**, kwaye into eza kwenziwa ngokuhamba kwexesha nge-**will + isenzi esiyisiseko**.

en-e4-l2.title: Imibuzo nezivakalisi ezingavumiyo
en-e4-l2.concept: Imibuzo iqala nge-**Do/Does**, kwaye xa kusithiwa hayi, sebenzisa u-**don't/doesn't**.

en-e4-l3.title: Amagama achaza imo neemvakalelo
en-e4-l3.concept: Ligama elichaza ukubonakala okanye imvakalelo njenge big (enkulu), small (encinci), hot (eshushu), cold (ebandayo).

en-e4-l5.title: Ukufunda umbhalo mfutshane
en-e4-l5.concept: Phendula ngokufumana kumbhalo ukuba ngubani, phi, kwaye wenze ntoni.

en-e5-l1.title: Ii-article, ubuninzi, There is/are
en-e5-l1.concept: Phambi kwesandi sevowuli sebenzisa **an**, phambi kwesandi sekhonsonanti sebenzisa **a**. Ukuba inye sebenzisa **There is**, ukuba zininzi sebenzisa **There are**.

en-e5-l2.title: Amagama okuthelekisa
en-e5-l2.concept: Xa uthelekisa ezimbini, sebenzisa **-er + than**, kwaye eyona nto ngeyona **the -est**. Kumagama amade sebenzisa **more**.

en-e5-l3.title: Amabinzana exesha elizayo
en-e5-l3.concept: Into eza kwenziwa ngokuhamba kwexesha ithethwa nge-**will + isenzi esiyisiseko** okanye nge-**be going to + isenzi esiyisiseko**.

en-e5-l4.title: Ukubhala kwakhona izivakalisi
en-e5-l4.concept: Kwizivakalisi ezingavumiyo sebenzisa **not / don't / doesn't / didn't**, kwaye kwimibuzo sebenzisa **Are / Do / Does** ekuqaleni kwesivakalisi.

en-e5-l5.title: Ukuqonda umbhalo
en-e5-l5.concept: Kumbhalo omde, kulula ukufunda ngokufumana ukuba ngubani, phi, nini nantoni, ngokungathi uzidwelisa.

en-e6-l1.title: Isishwankathelo samaxesha
en-e6-l1.concept: Into eyenzeka ngoku ithethwa nge-**be + -ing**, into edlulileyo nge-**ifom yexesha elidlulileyo**, kwaye into eza kwenziwa ngokuhamba kwexesha nge-**will / be going to**.

en-e6-l3.title: Ukwandisa amagama
en-e6-l3.concept: Ukufunda amagama anentsingiselo efanayo nawo achasene kunye kuyaphindwe kabini inani lamagama.

en-e6-l5.title: Ukufunda isiqendu
en-e6-l5.concept: Funda umbhalo onezivakalisi ezininzi uphendule ngokufumana ukuba ngubani, nini nasizathu sini.

en-e6-pun1.title: Oonobumba abakhulu nophawu lokubhala
en-e6-pun1.concept: Isivakalisi siqala ngo-**nobumba omkhulu** kwaye ekupheleni sebenzisa **uphawu lokubhala** olufanelekileyo. Isivakalisi esiqhelekileyo sisebenzisa ichaphaza (.), umbuzo uphawu lombuzo (?), kwaye ukumangaliswa okanye imvakalelo eyomeleleyo uphawu lokumangaliswa (!). Amagama abantu no-I ahlala enonobumba omkhulu.

en-e6-seq1.title: Ukuqonda ulandelelwano lwezehlo
en-e6-seq1.concept: Ukufumana amagama abonisa ulandelelwano anje nge-**First** (kuqala), **Then / Next** (emva koko), **After that** (emva koko), **Finally** (ekugqibeleni) kukunceda wazi ulandelelwano lwezehlo.

en-h1-l1.title: Amaxesha apheleleyo nawaqhubekayo
en-h1-l1.concept: had + p.p. ibonisa into eyenzeke ngaphambi kwexesha elidlulileyo, kwaye have been -ing ibonisa isenzo esiqhubekayo kude kube ngoku.

en-h1-l2.title: Izihlobo zesenzi nezivakalisi zesibizo
en-h1-l2.concept: I-where / when / why ziyizimelabizo ezisebenza njengezenzi-ncedisi, kwaye i-whether / that zikhokela izivakalisi zesibizo.

en-h1-l3.title: Amabinzana e-participle
en-h1-l3.concept: Nciphisa isidibanisi nesifundo uze utshintshe isenzi sibe ngu--ing. Isifundo ngokwentsingiselo kufuneka sifane.

en-h1-l4.title: Amagama adibanisayo nokuhamba kombhalo
en-h1-l4.concept: Hlula phakathi kwesizathu–isiphumo (so, therefore), ukuchasana (however), umzekelo (for example), ukongeza (in addition).

en-h1-l5.title: Ukuqonda inqaku eliphambili nokuqikelela indawo engenanto
en-h1-l5.concept: Inqaku eliphambili likumva kwe-However eguqula ingcamango eqhelekileyo nakwisivakalisi sokugqibela. Qikelela indawo engenanto ngokuhamba kwengxaki → isisombululo → isiphumo.

en-h2-l1.title: Ukuguqulwa komgaqo nokugxininisa
en-h2-l1.concept: Xa i-Never/Hardly/Only then iqala isivakalisi, ulandelelwano luba sisenzi esincedisayo + isifundo. Gxininisa nge-It is ~ that.

en-h2-l2.title: Imo yengcamango (subjunctive)
en-h2-l2.concept: Kwizivakalisi ze-I wish / as if / If, ukuchasana nangoku sebenzisa ixesha eledlule, ukuchasana nelidlulileyo sebenzisa i-had p.p.

en-h2-l3.title: Izihlobo ezintsonkothileyo nezivakalisi zokuvuma
en-h2-l3.concept: I-whatever, whoever, whichever, however + isichazi zithetha 'nokuba yintoni/ngubani/yeyiphi, nokuba kangakanani'.

en-h2-l4.title: Isigama kumxholo
en-h2-l4.concept: Qikelela intsingiselo yamagama angaqhelekanga usebenzisa imikhondo yokuchasana, yomzekelo, yesizathu nezandulelo.

en-h2-l5.title: Ukuhamba kwengqiqo yombhalo
en-h2-l5.concept: Landela ukuhamba kombhalo ngezinto ezikhonjwa zizalathisi namagama adibanisayo, uze uqokelele iinkcukacha ukufumana isigqibo.

en-h3-l1.title: Ulwakhiwo olufanayo nokuvumelana kwenani
en-h3-l1.concept: Amabinzana adityaniswe nge-and/but/or abe ngendlela efanayo, kwaye isenzi sivumelane nesifundo esiphambili.

en-h3-l2.title: Imo, ithoni nenjongo
en-h3-l2.concept: Qonda imo ngamagama achaza neemvakalelo, uze uqonde injongo yombhalo ngokuba iyacela, iyalathisa okanye iyazama ukonwabisa.

en-h3-l3.title: Ulandelelwano lwezivakalisi nokufakwa
en-h3-l3.concept: Cwangcisa izivakalisi usebenzisa imikhondo yamagama adibanisayo, izalathisi nolandelelwano lweminyaka, uze ufumane indawo apho isivakalisi esinikiweyo singena khona.

en-h3-l4.title: Ii-collocations neentetho ezingokwesiqhelo
en-h3-l4.concept: Funda izibini zamagama asetyenziswa kunye njenge-make a decision, take a risk, heavy rain, kwaye qikelela intsingiselo yeentetho ezingokwesiqhelo ngemeko.
en-h3-l4.example: the last straw = umda wokugqibela wokunyamezela

en-h3-l5.title: Ukugqibezela isishwankathelo
en-h3-l5.concept: Fumana iingcamango eziphambili zombhalo neentetho zokuchasana uze uzincede zibe sisivakalisi esinye.

en-h3e-l1.title: Ukukhetha into elungileyo kwimeko
en-h3e-l1.concept: Kwimibuzo yencoko, kufuneka ujonge ukuba igrama ichanekile kunye nokuba indlela yokuthetha ilula kwaye inembeko kuloo meko. Izindululo, ukuphazamisa, ukuphendula kwindumiso, iintetho ezingokwesiqhelo, nokuthetha ngokungathanga ngqo kuyabonakala rhoqo.

en-h3e-l2.title: Iintetho zendawo yomsebenzi nee-collocations
en-h3e-l2.concept: IsiNgesi sendawo yomsebenzi sijolise kwii-idiom (touch base), izifinyezo (njenge-ASAP), kunye nezibini zesenzi nesandulela-magama (ii-collocations). Musa ukuguqulela igama negama; zikhumbule njengamaqela asetyenziswa kwimeko yomsebenzi.

en-h3e-l3.title: Ukufunda ulwazi ngokuvavanya
en-h3e-l3.concept: KwisiNgesi semidiya, kubalulekile ukwahlula phakathi kwenyaniso nombono, nokuvavanya ukuba ingqiqo esetyenziswe kwingxoxo ivakala na. Khumbula namagama anje ngezichazi zemifanekiso (alt text, caption) okanye izixhobo zokuhlela ngokwenjongo yazo.

en-h3e-l4.title: Amagama enkcubeko nesimo esivulekileyo
en-h3e-l4.concept: Kwizihloko zenkcubeko yehlabathi, funda amagama aphambili afana ne-culture, diversity, stereotype, kunye nezivakalisi zokuzama ukuqonda enye inkcubeko ungayigwebi. Wahlule amagama abonakala efana ngentsingiselo ngokusebenzisa izingqinisiso zomxholo.

en-h3e-l5.title: Ukufunda imisebenzi yoncwadi ngamagama oncwadi
en-h3e-l5.concept: Imibuzo yoncwadi ibalulekile ekwazini inkcazo yegama kwaye uyisebenzise kwimiboniso yebali. Wahlule i-foreshadowing, uphawu, ijongo, umxholo, nendima yabalinganiswa.

en-h3e-l6.title: Ukwahlula ubungqina namaphosa
en-h3e-l6.concept: Kwiingxoxo kufuneka amandla okwahlula amagama (motion, rebuttal njalo njalo), iindidi zobungqina, namaphosa engqiqo. Xa uhlola ibango, qala ubuze ‘ubungqina balo mazwi buyintoni’.

en-h3e-l7.title: Ukubhala ngokuchanekileyo nangokuhambelana nenjongo
en-h3e-l7.concept: Ekubhaleni, khetha ifomathi ehambelana nenjongo yombhalo nomfundi, uze ujonge amalungu esivakalisi (isihloko nesenzi) nengqiqo yamagama adibanisayo. Imibhalo echanekileyo efana ne-CV ifuna izenzo namanani kunamazwi angacacanga.

en-l1.title: Ukufunda amagama oqhelekileyo
en-l1.concept: Amagama asetyenziswa rhoqo akhunjulwa ixesha elide ukuba ufunda **isandi + intsingiselo + ukubhala** kunye. Phulaphula ukubizwa ngoqinisekiso lwesipikha.
en-l1.example: library = ithala leencwadi / desk = idesika / milk = ubisi

en-l2.title: Isenzi se-be am / are / is
en-l2.concept: Isenzi se-be sitshintsha ifom ngokwesihloko. **I → am**, **he / she / it → is**, **you / we / they → are**.

en-l3.title: Isenzi esiqhelekileyo samanje
en-l3.concept: Ukuba isihloko yi-**he / she / it (umntu wesithathu obodwa)**, yongeza **-s / -es** kwisenzi. Ukuba siphela nge--ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o, yongeza -es, kwaye ukuba yi-consonant+y, tshintsha i-y ibe yi-i uze wongeze -es!

en-l4.title: Ubuninzi nokwakha izivakalisi
en-l4.concept: Ukuba isibizo sibini okanye ngaphezulu, ngokuqhelekileyo yongeza **-s**, kwaye ukuba siphela nge--x yongeza **-es**, kwaye ubuninzi obungaqhelekanga bukhunjulwa ngokwahlukileyo. Isivakalisi sihamba ngolu hlobo: **isihloko → isenzi → okunye**.

en-m2-l1.title: Present perfect
en-m2-l1.concept: have/has + past participle. Ibonisa amava, ukugqitywa, nokuqhubeka, kwaye wahlula phakathi kwe-since (ixesha elithile) ne-for (ixesha elide).

en-m2-l2.title: Isimo sokwenziwa
en-m2-l2.concept: be + past participle ibonisa 'ukwenziwa/ukwenzelwa'. Umenzi wongezwa nge-by.

en-m2-l3.title: To-infinitive ne-gerund
en-m2-l3.concept: want, hope, decide + to-infinitive, enjoy, finish, avoid + gerund. stop + to V yinjongo, stop + V-ing kukuyeka.

en-m2-l4.title: Izinga lokuthelekisa nelokuphezulu
en-m2-l4.concept: -er/-est kunye ne-more/most. Sebenzisa i-than kwizinga lokuthelekisa, kunye ne-the kwelokuphezulu. good → better → best ayingqinelanga.

en-m2-l5.title: Ukufunda: isihloko nemininingwane
en-m2-l5.concept: Funda umbuzo kuqala uze ufumane isivakalisi esinezingqinisiso. Isihloko kunye nesishwankathelo kuquka okuqulathwe kuso sonke isicatshulwa.

en-m2-sum1.title: Ukushwankathela umxholo wombhalo
en-m2-sum1.concept: Xa ushwankathela umbhalo, fumana **umxholo ophambili** uwunciphise ube sisivakalisi esinye okanye ezimbini. Isivakalisi esithetha ngenkcukacha enye kuphela, esongeza okungekho kumbhalo, okanye esithetha ngokubanzi kakhulu asikho sishwankathelo esihle.

en-m3-l1.title: Izabizwana ezinxulumene
en-m3-l1.concept: Dibanisa izivakalisi ezimbini zibe sisinye ngo-who (abantu), which (izinto), that (zombini), whose (ubunini).

en-m3-l2.title: Izivakalisi zemiqathango ne-past subjunctive
en-m3-l2.concept: If + present, will + V (into enokwenzeka). If + past, would + V (ingcamango eyahlukileyo kwangoku).

en-m3-l3.title: Imibuzo engaqondile
en-m3-l3.concept: Bhala ngolu hlelo: igama lombuzo + isihloko + isenzi. Awusebenzisi do/does/did.

en-m3-l4.title: Ii-participle
en-m3-l4.concept: -ing iyasebenza nokuqhubeka, -ed yipassive nokugqitywa. Kwiimvakalelo, ukuba ibangela sebenzisa -ing, ukuba uyiva sebenzisa -ed.

en-m3-l5.title: Ukufunda: ukuqikelela nenjongo yombhalo
en-m3-l5.concept: Dibanisa izalathisi ukuze uqikelele, kwaye injongo yombhalo imiselwa ngokubona izicelo neengxoxo.

e-be-1.prompt: I ____ a student. (Khetha elifanelekileyo phakathi kwe-am / are / is)
e-be-1.explanation: I ihlala isetyenziswa ne-am: I am a student.
hints: Kukho isenzi se-be esisetyenziswa xa isihloko yi-I.

e-be-2.explanation: Kumntu wesithathu obunye (She) sebenzisa i-is: She is my friend.
hints: Sesiphi isenzi se-be esisetyenziswa ne-he / she / it?

e-be-3.explanation: They ngobuninzi, ngoko i-are: They are in the classroom.
hints: Kwizihloko zobuninzi (we, you, they) sebenzisa i-are.

e-be-4.explanation: My brother = he, ngoko i-is: My brother is tall.
hints: My brother ngumntu omnye. Ngumntu wesingaphi?

e-be-5.explanation: We are ready. kuphela apho isihloko nesenzi se-be zihambelana.
hints: Jonga ijoda lesihloko nesenzi se-be ngalunye.
